en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a long, low building with a gabled central section on a river embankment. The sign on the facade reads "Erzgebirgische Hutzenstube" and there are advertising signs for "Freiberger Brau" beer. Leafless trees stand in front of the house and there is a terrace or garden area along the river wall. Handwritten captions appear along the bottom border.
